findings.evidence: dom-800.json records no name, role or title on the product svg; the only image of the product is silent to screen readers, and the hero's text stamps ('— SPORT TEST', 'DROP 04 · 04—2026') are read instead.

findings.where: all links: 'SHOP', 'JOURNAL', 'MEMBERS', 'Shop the Axis Pro', 'Unsubscribe', 'View in browser'
findings.evidence: Every href is '#'; link text is clear but none goes anywhere, including Unsubscribe.
findings.after: Real destination URLs for each link
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.4 Link Purpose (In Context): the stated purpose must be achievable.

findings.where: CTA 'SHOP THE AXIS PRO' and nav links
findings.evidence: focus.json: all six links rely on the UA 'auto 1px' outline; on the #1a1816 CTA button a 1px dark ring is not distinguishable (focus/03-on.png).
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.7 Focus Visible (applies in view-in-browser and webmail).

findings.where: inline accent 'Ember Flare' in body copy
findings.evidence: Sweep measured #d8482b on #f4efe7 at 3.76:1; the italic accent is also the only signal it is a product name. Confirmed visible in tile 800-02.
findings.after: Darken accent text to #b23a20 (>= 4.5:1) and keep italic

strengths: Responsive at 375 (nav hidden, headline steps down to 48px, no overflow); header, nav and footer landmarks present; lang and title set.
not_investigated: Email-client accessibility (role="presentation" on layout tables, Outlook rendering) cannot be assessed from a browser capture.
Sweep text-size hits on 11px mono labels agreed and not repeated.
